children: The annual inflation rate in Colombia rose to 6.24% in August 2026 from 6.03% in July, exceeding market expectations for a 6.1% gain and marking the fastest increase since July 2024.

The acceleration was driven by stronger price growth for furniture and household maintenance (6.67% vs 6.30% in July), housing and utilities (5.74% vs 5.40%), information and communication (5.97% vs 4.97%), recreation and culture (4.98% vs 3.74%), and miscellaneous goods and services (6.05% vs 5.97%).
Inflation also picked up for transport (5.25% vs 5.21%).

Meanwhile, price growth eased for food and non-alcoholic beverages (6.10% vs 5.82%), alcoholic beverages and tobacco (6.94% vs 7.14%), clothing and footwear (3.26% vs 3.38%), health (8.30% vs 8.37%), education (7.45% vs 7.57%), and restaurants and hotels (9.36% vs 9.53%).
On a monthly basis, consumer prices grew by 0.39% in August, topping forecasts for a 0.26% rise and July’s 0.17% gain.

title: Colombia Inflation Accelerates Above Forecasts
